verdict.rationale: WezTerm's docs show a built-in SSH client for ad-hoc connections with native tabs. They also describe SSH domains that connect to a remote wezterm multiplexer and preserve tabs, so the terminal's own SSH integration is real. Nothing in the evidence shows that this integration carries terminfo, shell integration, or the user's config to the remote host; shell integration is documented only as a local OSC 7 / user-var feature. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic terminfo propagation to remote hosts, evidence of shell integration being installed or activated over SSH, evidence of config being carried to remote sessions, independent hands-on corroboration of the SSH workflow.
